fix(bougainvillea): remove legacy non-frontend dirs

Summary:
- remove the legacy `bougainvillea/core` and `bougainvillea/wiki`
  trees so the workspace only contains the frontend monorepo
- update the camellia dashboard copy to describe the narrowed
  frontend-only scope

Rationale:
- the latest DAM-15 issue comment explicitly requires bougainvillea
  to stay frontend-only instead of carrying prior non-frontend paths
- keeping the cleanup in the same branch preserves the existing
  scaffold baseline while aligning the PR with current ticket intent

Tests:
- `cd bougainvillea && pnpm install`
- `cd bougainvillea && pnpm run typecheck:camellia`
- `cd bougainvillea && pnpm run build:camellia`
- `cd bougainvillea && pnpm run dev:camellia`
